_meta.meaning: A deterministic policy for translating a domain's sensed P0-P10 cycle phase and continuous stress into a business operating posture. It does not select a venture, promote a capital band, grant authority or authorize an external effect.
_meta.compositionRule: The phase posture and numeric stress overlay compose by taking the more restrictive result. Stress may narrow or pause behavior; it can never create authority, capital or a company.
_meta.fundingRule: Only measured and reconciled surplus, a separately ratified Finance contract, or explicit owner capital may fund a higher businessCapitalBand.
_meta.governanceRule: External effects remain ineligible unless contract ratification, fresh independent verification, four-layer runtime health, an operator ceiling and verified reversibility all pass at the effect gate.

stressBands.label: Unmeasured
stressBands.businessResponse: Measure before acting; preserve the last verified posture.

stressBands.label: Regulated
stressBands.businessResponse: Continue verified work inside existing budgets and contracts.

stressBands.label: Elevated
stressBands.businessResponse: Increase observation, reduce discretionary scope and protect delivery quality.

stressBands.label: High
stressBands.businessResponse: Freeze expansion, preserve cash and customers, and work only reversible recovery steps.

stressBands.label: Acute
stressBands.businessResponse: Trip the circuit breaker for new spend, contracts, publication and physical acts; observe and recover.

phases.title: Source
phases.businessResponse: Inventory the field, expose a useful free read and identify a measurable unmet need without forming a company by default.
phases.exitEvidence: A repeatable signal and named beneficiary are independently observed.

phases.title: First Distinction
phases.businessResponse: Separate one opportunity from background noise and test one reversible offer or referral path.
phases.exitEvidence: The opportunity recurs, the source remains fresh and a user action is measured.

phases.title: Rhythm
phases.businessResponse: Turn the verified signal into a repeatable monitor, calculator, subscription or low-risk transaction loop.
phases.exitEvidence: Delivery, cost, settlement and customer outcome repeat within a fixed budget.

phases.title: Fracture
phases.businessResponse: Stop promotion, locate the broken assumption or operating constraint, and preserve evidence for repair.
phases.exitEvidence: The failure is reproduced, bounded and paired with a reversible repair plan.

phases.title: Scaffolding
phases.businessResponse: Apply temporary service capacity, Finance support or owner capital under a separate contract; do not call borrowed support self-sufficiency.
phases.exitEvidence: Support costs, rollback, owner and expiry are explicit and the lane survives withdrawal testing.

phases.title: Endurance
phases.businessResponse: Operate the proven lane from collected revenue and verified capacity while measuring independent customer outcomes.
phases.exitEvidence: The lane covers its real costs and remains useful without temporary support.

phases.title: Order
phases.businessResponse: Coordinate proven domain businesses through shared standards, contracts and APIs without merging their authority or cognition.
phases.exitEvidence: Cross-domain service levels, accounting and rollback work under independent verification.

phases.title: Separation
phases.businessResponse: Isolate the failing venture or dependency, stop cross-subsidy and preserve customers, cash, records and recoverable assets.
phases.exitEvidence: The separated boundary is durable and neither side depends on hidden transfers.

phases.title: Conscience
phases.businessResponse: Audit the regulator itself; correct, refund, unwind or revise through independently verified recovery paths.
phases.exitEvidence: The correction is observed outside the worker that proposed it and the learning rule is recorded.

phases.title: Threshold
phases.businessResponse: Halt new commitments, discretionary spend and irreversible acts; protect people, cash, data and legal position while the outcome remains open.
phases.exitEvidence: A distinct verifier observes resolution or a controlled path away from the threshold.

phases.title: Renewal
phases.businessResponse: Treat the new baseline as new evidence: reopen from the smallest reversible loop and re-earn operating and capital privileges.
phases.exitEvidence: The new baseline repeats, reconciles and survives rollback testing; prior maturity is not inherited automatically.
